summary: Grievance create now supports an authorized initial status, progress stage, effective date, note, and status attachments with matching atomic history and escalation state.

changes: Added an Initial Status card for users with change_grievance_status
Loads progress stages from GET /api/grievance/options using the selected project
Moved grievance form configuration to HTML data attributes so JavaScript remains external
Validates create-time status permission, project-scoped stage, and effective date
Creates one status log matching the selected initial status and initializes escalation or closure fields atomically
Accepts optional initial status note and image/PDF status attachments
POST /api/grievance/store supports initial status history fields and multipart status attachments
Non-default initial status/history requires edit_grievance or change_grievance_status in addition to add_grievance
In Progress requires a valid project-scoped progress level
Updated create-form help, API contract, mobile integration guide, Postman collection generator, and CHANGES.md
No schema migration; existing database and public/uploads backup/restore coverage applies
